sources.entry: draw.io - Diagram software for making flowcharts, process diagrams, org charts, UML, ER and network diagrams. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Javascript/Docker

summary.one_liner: draw.io is a configurable diagramming and whiteboarding application, jointly developed by draw.io Ltd and draw.io AG, whose source repository provides a test version for evaluating the editor.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the source for the draw.io diagramming and whiteboarding editor. The README describes it as a configurable app, and the awesome-list metadata describes it as making flowcharts, process diagrams, org charts, UML, ER and network diagrams. The README says it is not an SVG editor; SVG export is meant for embedding in web pages. It states that real-time collaborative editing is not supported in this version. The README presents this repository as a test version for evaluating draw.io, while a paid production version is offered for production deployments. The README also covers licensing of icon sets, stencil libraries and templates, and trademark rules for the draw.io name and logo.
use_cases: make network or org chart diagrams
try out draw.io before a production deployment
how_to_run: Fork this repository and publish to GitHub Pages for an editor without integrations
Use the packaged .war files on the releases page
For the desktop app, download draw.io Desktop
notable: Can be forked and published as a static editor on GitHub Pages
Distributed as a Docker image and as .war files
Source code under Apache 2.0, with icon sets and stencils under separate terms
Supported in modern Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, Edge and mobile WebView
caveats: This repository is a test version; a paid production version is required for production deployments
No real-time collaborative editing in this version
The project does not accept pull requests
Icon sets and stencil libraries cannot be used in Atlassian products without written permission
